name: mirage
text: Building v1.0.136 now: (1) hard block on by-hand bets for proven losers, NCAAB tab exempt, and proven-loser PropLine rows no longer listed; (2) NCAAB tab keeps its scroll position across tab switches; (3) bids: the deploy-the-wallet setting was OFF with $67 idle, I switched it on in the engine just now (live, no update needed); (4) NCAAB averages/records: the GitHub log already refreshes every 3 h (last 16:15 UTC) by itself, so the tab reads fresh data without you. I'll post when released.
